trustBoundary: The local relay verifies P-256 signatures off-chain. The Solidity router enforces session owner, nonce, expiry, action scope, replay hash, execution mode, and opening-notional limits but does not verify the P-256 signature itself. The sequencer cannot use owner-only withdrawal functions, but production still requires audited on-chain or account-abstraction signature enforcement.
